Hi Cydney,
Thanks for your message; there can indeed be some confusion between webhook urls and async callback urls; please find below how we make a distinction between the two:
• Webhooks work for all content types; they are triggered either automatically by the rule engine or manually by moderators 
    ◦ Red threshold 
        ▪︎ whenever the content has been identified as being violative with high confidence (red threshold), a webhook will be triggered and sent to your service via the url that you have configured under the action configuration tab
    ◦ Orange threshold 
        ▪︎ whenever a content is processed by a moderator after it has been identified with medium confidence (orange threshold) or reported by any user; the webhook url called here is the one configured under the action configuration tab
• Green thresholds (non violative content)
    ◦ For text and images, the outcome of the providers are sent back immediately in the response from the API since they are sync requests; responses only contain  violative classes; 
• Async Callbacks: we introduced async callbacks urls configuration upon your request, and as a custom development, for videos only and in the situation where videos are considered as green or orange; this is only possible because video moderations requests are asynchronous. 
    ◦ Aysnc callbacks will call the url that you have configured in Nima under the "Async Callback URL tab"
        ▪︎ When the video is green: 
            • only the callback url will be called 
        ▪︎ When the video is orange 
            • callback url will be called 
            • webhook action url will be called when acted upon manually 
        ▪︎ When video is red 
            • only webhook action will be called 
            • no callback url will be called 
    ◦ It is NOT possible to have this url being called for images and text because images and text are not asynchronous requests 
Ultimately, we also recommend that you do not use the url that you are using for async callbacks for webhook actions because they service different purposes;
Initially we introduced the async callback url for videos because you needed to get notified as soon as possible if a video was considered as being uploadable to your audience; text and images do not require this callback moreover given the fact that these requests are synchronous, so you are able to know rapidly from our response whether the content is legit or not;
The following video attempts to explicit this functioning a little bit more:

messages.text:
Hi Team,
Just to let you know that we have rolled out `v2.25.6` to your  environment today:
Here's what's new in this version:
• *Redesigned* *Moderation* *Console* - We've moved to a case-centric approach. Moderators now see all reports on a piece of content in one place, with a fully customisable Reported Account section to surface the attributes that matter most to your workflow.
• *Custom* *Attributes* *in* *Prioritisation* - Build prioritisation rules based on custom attributes. They now appear in the criteria dropdowns alongside Channel and Label, with operators that reflect your attribute types.
• *Time-Based* *Prioritisation* *Scoring* - Cases are now prioritized by how long they've been pending and time until SLA deadline, giving urgency scores (Low, Medium, High, Severe) to help moderators tackle the most critical content first.
As always, all details here in our <https://docs.tremau.com/|documentation> :eyes: (psw: Tremau-Documentation2026^!?)
Let us know if you have any questions!
<http://docs.tremau.com|docs.tremau.com>

At this time, we are working closely with our member companies and multi-stakeholder partners to monitor developments, identify potential related online content, and provide support to members in addressing content relating to this incident. We thank our stakeholders for their continued engagement, and our thoughts remain with the victims and affected communities.

Hey team, just to let you know that we have rolled out `v2.28` to your environment today. Here's what's new in this version:
• *Faster, Redesigned Report Search* — The search experience on the Reports page has been significantly improved. Results now appear in seconds, and the search bar has moved into the Reports toolbar with an Advanced Search option for filtering by IDs, emails, and custom attributes.
• *Appeal Decision Visibility* — When an appeal overturns a moderation decision, the updated outcome is now shown directly in the Report List and Moderation Console, including the original decision for full context.
• *Policy Selection on Appeal After Ignore* — Reviewing an appeal against an "ignore" decision now prompts the moderator to select the applicable policy.
• *Enforcement Portal Raw Text* — The Enforcement Portal now displays the raw text content of reported items, giving users direct access to the original content.
• *AI Agent Enhancements* — The Agent configuration now shows the next scheduled run time, logs all configuration changes in the audit trail, and has been simplified by removing the batch size setting.
We've also shipped several fixes across the reports list, notification emails, Trusted Flagger validation, and the appeal form. As always, all details are available in our <https://docs.tremau.com/|documentation>. Happy to hear your feedback!

Hey team, just to let you know that we have rolled out `v2.29` to your environment today. Here's what's new in this version:

• *Policy Guidelines Drawer* — Moderators can now open a right-side drawer directly in the console to browse all platform policies and descriptions, without leaving an active case.
• *Pending Appeals Badge* — The Appeals tab now shows a badge with the count of pending appeals, so your team can spot unreviewed appeals at a glance.
• *Unread RFI Response Indicator* — An icon now appears in the report list and detail view when a reporter has sent a new Request for Information response that hasn't been read yet.
• *Action Webhook Alias* — Action webhooks now include a customizable alias field, displaying a user-friendly action name on the Enforcement Portal.
• *Report Age in Moderation Console* — Reports now show how long ago they were created (e.g. "2 days - 5 hours ago") to help moderators prioritize at a glance.
• *Revert Action — Previous Decision Context* — When reverting a decision, moderators can now toggle to see the original action, policy, and sub-policy that was overridden.
As always, all details are available in our <https://docs.tremau.com/|documentation>. Happy to get your feedback!

Hi TNM team,

We're reaching out to inform you that SightEngine has released improved OCR text detection models, and we're upgrading to them *from our next release*. You currently have 7 rules using the older versions, which will be dismissed, so you'd need to update to the new models.

The good news: it's straightforward - each old model maps to exactly a new one within your rules:

Video/Image - Illegal Substances          → `text.detections.drug.details`
Video/Image Terrorism Recruitment/Facil.  → `text.detections.extremism.details`
Image/Video Terrorism Advocacy Rule       → `text.detections.extremism.details`
Image - Weapon Sales                      → `text.detections.weapon.details`

Just swap the models in your rules and you're done. Let us know for any need!

Thanks!

Hey team, reaching out to let you know that we will be rolling out Nima `v2.3.0` soon. Here's what's new in this version:

• *Moderation Console - Redesigned List and Grid Views:* Moderators can now customize columns and filters per-queue to see what matters most, and T&S managers can configure which custom attributes and information appear in each queue from Queue settings. _Check out the video_ :eyes: _below to see it in action and how to configure it! Do not hesitate to reach out for any question on it!_
• *Agent Creation UX:* Improved form validation and clearer configuration indicators make it faster and easier to set up AI-Mod agents.
• *Interface Improvements:* Updated terminology across the platform, clearer policy organization with breadcrumb navigation on the Actions page, added user ID in reported account sections, and streamlined queue configuration for a more intuitive workflow.
• *Dynamic RFI Email Customization:* Customize subject and body text of RFI emails via environment variables.
*• AI Detection Updates:* Added support for SightEngine's new `self-harm` and `text-content-2.0` detection classes.

As always, all details are available in our <http://docs.tremau.com|documentation>. And very happy and curious to hear your feedback! :wink:
